description: This week's Top 5: weekend picks released Thursday 23:00 UK for Friday–Monday games; midweek picks released Monday 23:00 UK for Tuesday–Thursday games. Returns the set on show (WEEKEND or MIDWEEK), each with match, market, selection, tier, chance and result. Weekend set on show until Mon 23:00 UK (Tue 09:00 if a Monday game is settling); midweek (3-5 picks) until Fri 09:00. Between sets: a not-released error with the next release time. Use this when you want the strongest picks. Use get_betting_picks instead for one match. Read-only. 18+. Paid: 10.00 USDC per call, via x402 on Base. Charged only after the content is ready; nothing is charged when it is unavailable.
